facts: GPT-6 Luna with reasoning off, on Respan (one-provider-then-deepseek.ts in web; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash served every Freebuff Luna request from 2026-10-30 to 11-05, see docs/freebuff-project-understanding.md).

Dated retirements (product, 2026-11-05, Victor): GLM 5.3 Flash leaves Freebuff in two steps, a slow removal rather than a cut. GPT-6 Luna was on the same schedule until, the same evening, Respan's fix to its prompt cache made it cheaper to serve than DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and it stayed.

ai.title: Remove GPT-6 Luna from free model retirement schedule
ai.summary: The `openai/gpt-6-luna` entry was removed from `FREEBUFF_SCHEDULED_RETIREMENTS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-model-retirement-schedule.ts`, stopping the two-step retirement mechanism (closesAt, endsAt) for that model. The module now schedules only `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` for retirement. This change reflects the fact that a Respan prompt-cache fix on November 5, 2026 made GPT-6 Luna cheaper to serve than DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, so it remained in the free model picker. Updated comments in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` clarify that the project-understanding agent uses GPT-6 Luna on Respan, documenting the routing shift away from the DeepSeek substitution that had been in place since October 30.
ai.evidence: In common/src/constants/freebuff-model-retirement-schedule.ts, the `openai/gpt-6-luna` key is removed from `FREEBUFF_SCHEDULED_RETIREMENTS`, leaving only `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`. In common/src/constants/free-agents.ts, the JSDoc for `FREEBUFF_PROJECT_UNDERSTANDING_MODEL_ID` is updated to note that Respan's fix made GPT-6 Luna cheaper to serve than DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
ai.unknowns: The specific prompt-cache changes in Respan that reduced GPT-6 Luna serving costs are not detailed in this diff.

eli5.text: The planned shutdown of the GPT-6 Luna model in the free version of the coding assistant was canceled because a recent fix made it cheaper to run than the alternative model it was supposed to be replaced with. Users on the free tier can continue to use GPT-6 Luna without interruption, while the scheduled removal of a different model, GLM 5.3 Flash, proceeds as originally planned. You will not see any error messages or need to switch your settings; the assistant simply keeps working with the same model you already chose.
